private_life_review.finding: Contemporary reporting explicitly discussed a possible romantic relationship, with different interpretations of Petzner’s public statements. The earlier dossier omitted that disagreement. Petzner’s emotional language is documented; sexual orientation remains unassigned. The final-evening account must be assessed separately from the relationship reporting.
private_life_review.publication: Preserve attributed contemporary reporting and its disagreement in the dossier. No categorical sexual-orientation label or private-life scandal card.
private_life_review.public_policy_followup: Locate the exact parliamentary motion and Haider’s recorded vote on the age of consent before asserting legislative hypocrisy. A press report alone does not establish the individual vote.

source_conflicts.issue: Parliament’s biography compresses BZÖ leadership into April 2005–October 2008. Exact chairmanship intervals and other chairholders must be checked against party congress records.
